notes: Graph traversal along a frontmatter relation. `after:` names the note BEFORE this one (Brendan's `terms/fields/after.md`: 'the documents that come before this one in a sequence'; each note carries one side), so the forward walk is the inverse relation — `follow ^docs { after == ^_path }` (spec/oqx §follow: a destination block computes the successors per frontier row). OQX caps a walk at depth 8 (the seed is depth 1), so an 11-note chain takes two walks: the first ends on `Integration with the dome` with `$frontier: true`, the second re-seeds from it. `refs(after)` walks the chain backwards from the closeout just as well.
